figure.description: Geometry is derived from values. State changes presentation, never the represented values.

stateBehavior.emphasis: Local emphasis stroke; represented values and geometry unchanged.
stateBehavior.excluded: Excluded annotation; retained values remain readable.
stateBehavior.complete: Neutral completion tick inside the control; the control is inert.
stateBehavior.attention: Two outline pulses; reduced motion removes animation.
stateBehavior.correct: Judged correct, external check; on a stage object the check sits beside it (mark()).
stateBehavior.wrong: Judged wrong, external cross; answer retained; on a stage object the cross sits beside it and the mark stays until the question is solved (mark()).
